question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

I __was look forward to helping__ you complete the project.
solution:
The correct answer is: **look forward to helping**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Remove "**was**" to make the sentence correct.
 
• "Look forward to something" is used to say that you are happy that something is going to happen.
 
• "I was look forward" is **grammatically incorrect**.
 
• If we want to put "was" in this sentence then we have to say "I was looking forward" but it is not given in the options.
 
• So, we have to convert the sentence into the present tense.
 
• "**Look forward to**" is a phrasal verb, which means to await something eagerly.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: I'm eager to assist you in doing the task.
 
• So, "**I look forward to helping...**" is the best choice for the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence:** *I look forward to helping you complete the project.*
